int_name: W HUNTING PARK AVE & W ROOSEVELT BLVD

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and curb ramps, but the environment is degraded. The sidewalk surface is in poor condition with significant cracking, and there is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signalization.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is heavily cracked and uneven with vegetation growth, creating a trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left and center sidewalk areas

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve safety and clarity for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features a very wide roadway with multiple lanes, resulting in long crossing distances for pedestrians. While sidewalks and some faded crosswalk markings are present, the lack of refuge islands and the overall scale of the infrastructure prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade faded markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at corners to shorten crossing distances and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signals. However, the large crossing distance and lack of physical traffic calming measures like medians or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk during pedestrian crossings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings for better visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway and a severely degraded sidewalk that is overgrown and cracked. While a signalized intersection is visible in the distance, the immediate infrastructure lacks adequate maintenance and protection for people walking.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk is severely cracked and overgrown with vegetation, creating significant trip hazards and making it inaccessible.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The ladder-style crosswalk markings across the side entrance are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install new, high-visibility thermoplastic crosswalk markings at all crossing points to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island on the main roadway to reduce exposure time and simplify the crossing task.
